regions.merged_text: "To know is to appreciate -- is to love the good and to reject the unworthy. God Himself will be no exception in this. "God is Charity," St. John tells us, and Saint Francis laments: "Love is not loved." Ah! because not known! But if artists can be known by their masterpieces, why should not the divine Architect ofthe Universe by known by His ?- Theologians are quite agreed that Mary, our Blessed Mother -- Virgin Mother of Jesus -- was so imbued with divine gifts and graces-even at her very Immaculate Conception-as to surpass in beauty of sanctity all other creatures combined The following pages, even abridged as they are, offer a surpassing introduction to God's own Mother, being the Autobiography of the same outstanding and supreme Masterpiece of all Masterpieces of the Universe -- most inspired-like and most inspiring - when read with becoming reverence.
